spend_amount.description:
what this row adds to spending by the verdict's own math (net of a
partial reimbursement; under the search's category filter, a split
row's matching parts' share — the same figure the search's spend sum
totals); 0 when it does not count. Day subtotals sum this, not
amount
spend_amount.title: Spend Amount

split.description:
a split of this charge across categories, in order — stored category
keys and cent-exact amounts summing to `amount`; null when the row
is not split. `category` stays the whole row's own; the rollups
count the parts. `split_source` says whether a person or a store
receipt wrote them
split.title: Split

split_source.description:
who wrote `split`: 'user' for a hand split, 'amazon' / 'costco' for
the parts a matched store receipt's items name (recomputed on every
match; a person's edit replaces them, a person's remove pins the row
whole); null when the row is not split
split_source.title: Split Source

splittable.description:
true when the split door will take this row — the spend test the
rollups use (money out, not a transfer, not a card payment, not on a
loan account); clients offer Split and Edit split only when true
splittable.title: Splittable

Txn.title: Txn

TxnCategory.description:
POST /api/transactions/{id}/category: "" clears the override; scope
"all" also writes the merchant's rule.
TxnCategory.title: TxnCategory

TxnNote.description: An empty string or null clears the note.
TxnNote.title: TxnNote

TxnPage.description:
GET /api/transactions: a month (mode "month") or a search (mode
"search"); each mode's figures are absent from the other.

day_spend.description:
Each listed day's spending (ISO date → amount) over ALL of that
day's rows in the result, pages and "show more" chunks not yet shown
included, by the rule each row's spend_amount follows: the figure a
day divider prints.
day_spend.title: Day Spend

drill_label.description:
a Spending figure's rows (`spend=`): what the chip over them says
they are, with the days they were read over — "Groceries · Dec
2025–Nov 2026"; amount_sum is that figure. Absent otherwise
drill_label.title: Drill Label

flow.description:
the matched rows' money out / in / net — a plain search's headline
(the month tiles' definitions); null for a budget bucket's or a counted
category's rows (their headline is the label's own number) and under
the business-only scope

listed_scope.description:
Whose spending listed_spend counts: "business" when every listed row
is a business's by the household test the aggregates use, else
"household".
listed_scope.title: Listed Scope

listed_spend.description:
What the listed rows spent (their spend_amount summed): the line a
month narrowed by a lens prints. When every listed row is a
business's, that business spending instead (see listed_scope).
listed_spend.title: Listed Spend

ranges.description:
what each range button (cur, 1m, 3m, 6m, 1y, 3y, 5y, all) sets as
the date filter, by Cash Flow's own windows (engine.reporting.
ledger_ranges): complete months for every key but "cur" (this month
to today) and "all" (no bound). Present in every mode
ranges.title: Ranges

TxnPage.title: TxnPage

UnlinkedMovements.description:
GET /api/doctor/unlinked-movements: equity movements whose
transaction is gone.
UnlinkedMovements.title: UnlinkedMovements

UserNotifySet.description:
POST /api/users/{id}/notify (owner): one or more of the member's
switches.
UserNotifySet.title: UserNotifySet

UserRemove.description:
DELETE /api/users/{id}: the step-up proof, when an older client
sends one; the body may be left out.
UserRemove.title: UserRemove

VendorMark.description:
Left out, `reportable` is true and the TIN on file is kept; a TIN
sent ("" or null clears it) keeps only its digits.
VendorMark.title: VendorMark

VerifyResent.description:
POST /api/verify-email/resend: `verified` true means nothing was
left to do and nothing was sent.
VerifyResent.title: VerifyResent

W2Person.description:
One person a W-2 can be filed under, as the whose-picker offers it
(taxdocs.w2_people).
W2Person.title: W2Person

W2Seen.description:
What the stored list showed for the W-2, so a reused id never acts
on another form.
W2Seen.title: W2Seen

WaitingReceipt.description: A receipt snapped before its transaction reached the ledger.

counts.description:
its lines are the ones counted for its slip (false: another copy
is counted)
counts.title: Counts

slip_twins.description: the other receipts of its slip
slip_twins.title: Slip Twins

suspected.description: receipts read exactly alike that are not its slip
suspected.title: Suspected

tie.description: two charges fit equally well: the choice is left to a person
tie.title: Tie

WaitingReceipt.title: WaitingReceipt

WaitingReceipts.description:
GET /api/receipts/waiting: `count` is every receipt waiting,
`waiting` one page of them from `offset`.
WaitingReceipts.title: WaitingReceipts

credential.description: The authenticator's assertion, as the browser API returns it.
credential.title: Credential

A webhook as its owner manages it; the signing secret is never in
it.

key to every row it cleans.

WebhookUpdate.title: WebhookUpdate

The create and rotate replies: the signing secret, shown this
once.

created_by.description: The address of the member who added it.

events.description: Event names, or "*" alone for every event.
events.title: Events

WidgetToken.description:
POST /api/devices/widget: the home-screen widget's token, shown
this once.
WidgetToken.title: WidgetToken

YearCell.description:
One month of the year: a future month carries no figures, a month
before the ledger only its money in and out.

figure.description:
...and the figure under it, as printed ("+$1,200", "−$300",
"$450"); null for a month with no data. Under a verdict, the margin
in words ("over by $300", "under by $120", "on budget").
figure.title: Figure

label.description:
The pill of a cell that is not a verdict (lenses.cell_words):
"net", "spent" when the month's income is not measured, "no data".
label.title: Label

note.description:
"income incomplete" on a month the bank feed does not measure: the
cell is drawn greyed.
note.title: Note

YearCell.title: YearCell

categories.description: [label, this year, last year, stored key]
categories.title: Categories

detail.description: the Cash Flow page's detail; this door sends null
detail.title: Detail

excess_text.description:
"An ordinary month leaves about $X" (the standing surplus per
month), printed under the Yearly budget card; null with nothing
budgeted, no surplus, or the year to date over budget.
excess_text.title: Excess Text

plan_caption.description:
Which months the Yearly budget card covers ("Aug–Nov, the months
with a budget"); null when there is no map.
plan_caption.title: Plan Caption

plan_rows.description:
The year's money map rows over its elapsed budgeted months; null
when none has elapsed (no map).
plan_rows.title: Plan Rows

incomplete_text.description:
Set when some elapsed month has incomplete income ("income
incomplete — left over counts 8 of 12 months"): income, saved and the
rate count the other months. Printed under the totals.
incomplete_text.title: Incomplete Text

YearTotalsDollars.description:
The totals in the whole dollars the page prints
(lenses.totals_dollars): when every month's income is known, left over
is printed income less printed spend.
YearTotalsDollars.title: YearTotalsDollars

YnabAccountsAnswer.description:
Where each YNAB account goes: an account id, "skip", {new: name},
or {id, typed}.
YnabAccountsAnswer.title: YnabAccountsAnswer

YnabAccountsNeeded.title: YnabAccountsNeeded
